appearances.snippet: Apparently Tyler Bowyer (Tyler Bowyer) has a younger brother who—for 10 years—has worked in dental sales until Charlie (Charlie Kirk) died, because a unique opportunity presented itself at Turning Point USA where Tyler (Tyler Bowyer) had begun telling people that TPUSA plans to roll out a program to build houses for first-time home buyers.
